name: Frostcrown Town
chat: Welcome to Frostcrown Town! The air is thin, the rent is not.
The higher you live here, the richer you are. I live on the bottom row.
Leader Alta trains at the very top. Bring a scarf.
You can ride across Mirrormere Lake to Clovercrest Town, if your Billie can swim.
The snowman by the clinic is called Gerald. Do not touch Gerald.
Every chalet here has a view. Most of them are of other chalets.
Upper Village is past the last street. The pond freezes so hard you could skate on it.
The cocoa stall takes coins, cards and future earnings.

props.say: Town Hall: “The mountain is closed for tax reasons.”
The snowman says nothing. It’s a snowman.
